channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Protein identified as key obstacle to nerve repair
item.description: Scientists found that a protein called AHR acts as a brake on nerve repair. Blocking it helped injured nerves regenerate.

item.title: Australia's iron-rich rocks could yield abundant clean hydrogen
item.description: Researchers found that Western Australia's iron-rich rocks naturally generate hydrogen, and the process could be enhanced for large-scale production.

item.title: Sleep disruptions may signal early Alzheimer's risk
item.description: In healthy middle-aged adults without symptoms, frequent brief awakenings during sleep were associated with a higher genetic risk for Alzheimer's disease.

item.title: Experimental eye drops restore vision in blind mice
item.description: Researchers developed light-sensitive drugs that enabled blind mice to perceive light and regain visually guided behavior without gene therapy.
